headline: FLUX 3 x Mimic is the next generation of video-action models.
summary: Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 multimodal foundation model, in partnership with Mimic Robotics, now powers next-generation video-action models for robots. These models have been tested and deployed at Audi, demonstrating advanced physical AI capabilities.
details: An early version of FLUX 3, Black Forest Labs' new multimodal foundation model, is now running on robots. This was achieved through a collaboration with Mimic Robotics, resulting in FLUX-mimic: the next generation of video-action models. These models have already been tested and deployed at Audi.

While FLUX 1 and 2 generated images, FLUX 3 expands into multimodality, jointly generating audio-visual content. This same foundation also enables FLUX-mimic to control robots. The model learns how the physical world behaves, making content creation and robot manipulation two applications of one underlying world model.

FLUX 3 is a single model, jointly trained across images, video, and audio from the outset. Video prediction is the most demanding part of this training, accounting for over 95% of total compute costs. To generate realistic videos, the model must learn contact, motion, weight, cause, and effect, effectively modeling physical world behavior.

Adding action prediction to FLUX 3's training curriculum initially caused a temporary 10% drop in video generation quality. However, after 3500 steps, the model fully regained its previous video generation quality while also predicting actions. This demonstrates that the model can integrate new modalities without permanent capacity loss.

This integration proves that video generation and action prediction do not require separate foundations; the same backbone carries both capabilities. This makes Physical AI a natural extension of Black Forest Labs' roadmap. The FLUX 3 backbone, with visual intelligence at its core, enables both content creation and physical actions.
caption:
A single AI model now generates audio-visual content AND controls robots. See how FLUX 3 x Mimic is redefining physical AI.

An early version of FLUX 3, Black Forest Labs' new multimodal foundation model, is now running on robots. This was achieved through a collaboration with Mimic Robotics, resulting in FLUX-mimic: the next generation of video-action models. These models have already been tested and deployed at Audi.

While FLUX 1 and 2 generated images, FLUX 3 expands into multimodality, jointly generating audio-visual content. This same foundation also enables FLUX-mimic to control robots. The model learns how the physical world behaves, making content creation and robot manipulation two applications of one underlying world model.

FLUX 3 is a single model, jointly trained across images, video, and audio from the outset. Video prediction is the most demanding part of this training, accounting for over 95% of total compute costs. To generate realistic videos, the model must learn contact, motion, weight, cause, and effect, effectively modeling physical world behavior.

Adding action prediction to FLUX 3's training curriculum initially caused a temporary 10% drop in video generation quality. However, after 3500 steps, the model fully regained its previous video generation quality while also predicting actions. This demonstrates that the model can integrate new modalities without permanent capacity loss.

This integration proves that video generation and action prediction do not require separate foundations; the same backbone carries both capabilities. This makes Physical AI a natural extension of Black Forest Labs' roadmap. The FLUX 3 backbone, with visual intelligence at its core, enables both content creation and physical actions.
